name: flowguard

interface.shortDescription: 研发流程门禁：十阶段 SDLC 硬门禁编排
interface.longDescription: 十阶段 SDLC 流水线：需求分析、架构设计、技术方案、测试用例、概要设计、详细设计、编码规范、代码审查、文档生成、部署交付。多功能并行、模块归属判定、硬门禁留痕、REQ 追溯。

description: SDLC orchestration plugin with hard stage gates: a ten-stage pipeline (requirements, architecture, solution, test cases, HLD, LLD, coding standards, review, docs, release) across multiple features and modules.
